Part one. 2025 Passive Activity Loss. Rental Real Estate Activities with Active Participation. Line 1 a. Activities with net income from Part four, column (a).
Line 1 b. Activities with net loss from Part four, column (b).
Line 1 c. Prior year unallowed losses from Part four, column (c).
Line 1 d. Combine line 1 a, line 1 b, and line 1 c.
All Other Passive Activities. Line 2 a. Activities with net income from Part five, column (a).
Line 2 b. Activities with net loss from Part five, column (b).
Line 2 c. Prior year unallowed losses from Part five, column (c).
Line 2 d. Combine line 2 a, line 2 b, and line 2 c.

Line 3. Combine line 1 d and line 2 d. If the result is net income or zero, see the instructions for line 3. If line 3 and line 1 d are losses, go to line 4. Otherwise, enter zero on line 9 and go to line 10. See instructions.
Part two. Special Allowance for Rental Real Estate Activities with Active Participation. Line 4. Enter the smaller of losses from line 1 d or line 3.
Line 5. Enter $150,000. If married/Registered Domestic Partner filing a separate tax return, see instructions.

Line 6. Enter federal modified adjusted gross income, but not less than zero. See instructions. If line 6 is greater than or equal to line 5, skip line 7 and line 8, enter zero on line 9, and then go to line 10. Otherwise, go to line 7.
Line 7. Subtract line 6 from line 5.
Line 8. Multiply line 7 by 50% (.50). Do not enter more than $25,000.
Line 9. Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 8.
Part three. Total Losses Allowed. Line 10. Add the income, if any, from line 1 a and line 2 a and enter the total.
Line 11. Total losses allowed from all passive activities for 2025. Add line 9 and line 10. See the instructions on Page 2 to find out how to report the losses on your tax return.
